claim_scope: Almost-sure convergence of finite-dimensional exact-oracle norm estimates with constant-vector storage; not deterministic finite-time certification, floating-point stability, arbitrary infinite-dimensional convergence, or every source step-size schedule.
source_cautions: Mismatch v2 Proposition 2.11 projected-determinant nonvanishing fails for nonzero rank-one maps, including admissible nonsingular initial pairs.
Mismatch v2 Theorem 2.26 uses an invalid product-of-failures bound; the frozen proof independently uses 1-p_m*p_d and compares objective values.
independent_proof_result: The compact plane-SVD method and history-uniform conditional cap argument avoid both defects and establish the claimed norm convergence.
